messages:
lee: Hi folks, first-week oncall here. Shadow shift scheduled 2026-04-08 09:00-13:00. Quick: who handles swap requests and where's the short runbook?
olivia_ops: Welcome! Ping @olivia_ops for swaps; if I'm out, ping @natalie. Short runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/oncall/quick-start (SSO required).
lee: SSO still pending, I submitted the request. Can someone grant temporary access?
olivia_ops: Post your work email here and I'll add a temporary viewer link. Also follow this mini-checklist before shift: 1) confirm PagerDuty routing, 2) read quick-start, 3) run `./scripts/runbook-check.sh`, 4) join #eng-oncall 15m early.
natalie: Two tips: A) Canary rollouts may spike noisy alerts, don't mute pages, treat them as training. B) Incident summary template is in quick-start (very short).
lee: Thanks! Posting email to Olivia via DM. If IT doesn't approve SSO by Friday, should I still show up for shadow?
olivia_ops: Yes, show up. We'll give a temporary link and pair you with Natalie.
pager-bot: Reminder: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-08 08:30 UTC for inference-runtime v2.4.0 — expect minor latency noise.
lee: Got it, thanks everyone!
